symptom: A Starlark rule could not tie a caption in another language to its enumeration value: enumerations().values had name, qualified_name, caption (default language) and ordinal, and strings() rows for Enumerations$EnumerationValue.Caption carried an element_id that matched nothing a rule could see. `v.id` stopped the rule with 'enumeration_value struct has no .id attribute'.
cause: The value's Id was in enumeration_values_data all along and equals the translations walk's ElementID (the owner's $ID); the linter query did not select it.
insight: Half of #1301 had already shipped with #1453, so the issue looked done; read the issue's Expected section line by line before closing as stale. Measure the join in SQL before writing code: on CitrusGrove `strings s left join enumeration_values v on v.Id = s.ElementId` matched 144 of 144 caption rows, which settled that exposing the id was the whole fix. A user module is needed to see it end to end: enumerations() leaves out Marketplace modules, and CitrusGrove's own modules have none, so the first run reported values=0.
